In
this link

posts.author: TheoAllen
posts.body:
LyonBuster said:
is there any plugin converter from MZ to MV?
Click to expand...
Most of the data structures are the same. So you don't need to convert most of the MZ data structure to MV, with an exception to animation (MZ uses Effekseer) and probably the system.
LyonBuster said:
map structure
Click to expand...
Map data structure (as in Map00x.json and MapInfos.json) appears to be the same, but don't quote me on that. I don't have MV right now to check my claim, but I see no reason why the map structure has to be different. Yes, MZ has multiple layers, but it goes the same as MV. The MV editor just does not have access to the layer system in the editor.
As for animation data, there is no way to convert it to MV unless there is a plugin to play Effekseer animation in MV.

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
Well, so as far as I understood, you want to convert Plugins, not Projects, from MZ to MV? There are more changes in the code base of MV and MZ than just Animation etc. For instance, in MZ Window_Base accepts a Rectangle as argument, whereas MV accepts x, y, w, h. Well, this can be solved by writing a Plugin for sure, like
this one
, just the other way round.. But still, there are many changes between MV and MZ code, so I doubt that you can write a converter that magically converts Plugins.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
A little more to the point...MV has been around for years and has tons of plugins. Most of the work done for MZ plugins so far is to replicate/port plugins that were already written for MV.
What are you looking at for MZ plugins that don't already exist for MV?
